question_pt: Quais codigos de municipio de residencia sem correspondencia aparecem com maior volume de internacoes?
sql: SELECT i."MUNIC_RES" AS codigo_municipio_residencia, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE i."MUNIC_RES" IS NOT NULL AND m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" IS NULL GROUP BY i."MUNIC_RES" ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10
